min_diff = float('inf')
answer_b = 0

def check_and_update(b, a):
    global min_diff, answer_b, answer_a
    diff = abs((a / b) - (x / y))
    if diff + 1e-15 < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff
        answer_b = b
        answer_a = a

for b in range(1, n + 1):
    a_candidate1 = (x * b) // y
    a_candidate2 = a_candidate1 + 1
    check_and_update(b, a_candidate1)
    check_and_update(b, a_candidate2)
